proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_mechanics.on_hit_trigger
proposed_widenings.justification: Frost Brand's core weapon rider is an item-scoped on-hit trigger. The current magic-item surface only allows passive, activation, or composites of those two, while on-hit riders exist only for masteries.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit with an attack roll using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra 1d6 Cold damage.

proposed_widenings.name: extinguish_nonmagical_flames
proposed_widenings.justification: The draw-triggered property has a deterministic environmental effect that is not representable by any current effect atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you draw this weapon, you can extinguish all nonmagical flames within 30 feet of yourself.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because any valid current magic-item encoding would omit or falsify the primary on-hit cold-damage rider. The fire resistance passive fits, and the light-shedding clause is secondary caller/environment state, but the unit as a whole is not an honest fit.
